title: Tuple with Same Product
summary: For an array of distinct positive integers, count the number of quadruples (a, b, c, d) where the product of the first two equals the product of the last two, with all elements being unique and distinct.
statement: For an array of distinct positive integers, count the number of quadruples (a, b, c, d) where the product of the first two equals the product of the last two, with all elements being unique and distinct.
constraints: Count ordered tuples (a,b,c,d) using four distinct array values with a*b == c*d.
hints: Each two unordered pairs with the same product use four distinct values because nums is distinct.
Count earlier pairs by product while enumerating each new pair.
A new pair forms products[product] pair-of-pairs, each contributing 2*2*2=8 ordered tuples.
The three factors of two choose pair order and the order within each pair, covering every valid tuple exactly once.
